listing.title: Weekend Athletic Club Est. 1994 | Weekend Shirt | Athletic Club Shirt | Preppy Shirt | Vintage Style Tee | Retro Varsity Shirt
listing.description:
Weekend Athletic Club Est. 1994 - a vintage-inspired varsity tee with a worn-in print look.

- Soft, garment-dyed style tee, relaxed fit (size up for oversized)
- Printed to order just for you by our production partner
- The distressed texture is part of the design
- Colorway: Navy On Ivory

Care: wash inside out, cold, hang dry to keep the print looking great.
